mentions.name: Atom
mentions.description: Atom is a safer AI agent system for SMBs that bridges the gap between internal and external knowledge systems. It trains agents on the business's specific use case, progressing agents through stages (students -> interns -> supervised -> independent) before they operate usefully for the business. Currently in alpha.
mentions.problem: Internal and external knowledge systems are completely different: internal knowledge is very specific business context and/or the business's value prop that allows charging clients for access.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building a safer Agent system for SMBs.

The biggest problem is internal knowledge and external knowledge systems are completely different.
